title: Hydrogen peroxide decomposition
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
statement:
Use practice values $\Delta H_f^\circ(\ce{H2O2(l)})=-188$ and $\Delta H_f^\circ(\ce{H2O(l)})=-286$ kJ/mol. Find $\Delta H^\circ$ for $\ce{2H2O2(l) -> 2H2O(l) + O2(g)}$.

[_]{a}

explanations: Both coefficients and the subtraction are correct.
